description:
Krissy King Swimwear was founded with the belief that fashion and function can coexist in swimwear. Our founder, Krissy King, was a lifelong fashionista who struggled to find swimwear that could keep up with her active lifestyle while also reflecting her personal style. She noticed that the swimwear industry was lacking in quality, high-performance options that were also fashion-forward.

Determined to fill this gap in the market, Krissy started experimenting with different materials and designs, combining high-performance fabrics with fashion-forward styles. She worked tirelessly to perfect each piece, ensuring that they not only looked amazing but also performed well in the water.

Through her hard work and dedication, Krissy King Swimwear was born. Today, our brand is known for its functional luxury swimwear, designed to empower women to feel confident and comfortable while doing what they love. Our pieces are made from the highest quality materials, ensuring they can withstand the demands of an active lifestyle while still looking and feeling luxurious.

We believe that everyone deserves to feel beautiful and confident in their swimwear, regardless of their body type or level of activity. That's why we offer a wide range of sizes and styles, ensuring there's something for everyone in our collection. Whether you're lounging by the pool, hitting the beach, or competing in a swim meet, Krissy King Swimwear has you covered.

At the heart of our brand is a passion for empowering women to feel confident and beautiful in their own skin. We believe that by combining fashion and function, we can help women feel their best and achieve their goals, both in and out of the water.

USP (Unique Selling Points)

  1. High-quality materials: Krissy King Swimwear is made from the highest quality materials, ensuring our pieces can withstand the demands of an active lifestyle while still looking and feeling luxurious.

  2. Fashion-forward designs: Our swimwear is not only functional but also fashion-forward. Our designs are always on-trend, making Krissy King Swimwear the perfect choice for fashion-conscious consumers.

  3. Versatility: Our pieces are versatile enough to be worn both in and out of the water. From beachside brunches to rooftop pool parties, our swimwear is the perfect addition to any summer outfit.

  4. Range of sizes: We offer a wide range of sizes, ensuring there's something for every body type in our collection. From petite to plus size, Krissy King Swimwear has you covered.

  5. Sustainable practices: We are committed to reducing our environmental impact by using eco-friendly materials and sustainable manufacturing practices.

  6. Positive brand image: Krissy King Swimwear is a brand that empowers women to feel confident and beautiful in their own skin. By partnering with us, affiliates can align themselves with a brand that promotes body positivity and self-love.

  7. Great commission rates: We offer competitive commission rates to our affiliates, ensuring they can earn a generous income while promoting a brand they believe in.

Payment Terms

Krissy King Swimwear offers the following payment terms for our affiliates:

  1. Commission rate: We offer a commission rate starting at 10% on all sales made through affiliate links.

  2. Payment frequency: Payments are made on a weekly basis, with a minimum payout threshold of $50.

  3. Payment method: We offer payment via PayPal.

  4. Cookie duration: Our cookie duration is 30 days, meaning that if a customer makes a purchase within 30 days of clicking on an affiliate link, the commission will be credited to the affiliate.

  5. No commission on returns: We do not offer commission on returns or canceled orders.

  6. Affiliate support: Our team is always available to provide support to our affiliates and answer any questions they may have.

We believe that our payment terms are fair and competitive, and we are committed to providing our affiliates with the tools and resources they need to succeed.


Other Benefits

In addition to our competitive commission rates and payment terms, Krissy King Swimwear also offers our affiliates the following benefits:

  1. Access to fashion weeks: We offer our top-performing affiliates the opportunity to attend fashion weeks and other industry events, providing them with an exclusive look at our latest collections and upcoming trends.

  2. Social events: We host a variety of social events throughout the year, including launch parties and influencer gatherings. Our affiliates are invited to attend these events, giving them the chance to network with other industry professionals and build relationships with our team.

  3. Marketing support: We provide our affiliates with a range of marketing materials, including banners, product images, and social media content, to help them promote our brand effectively.

  4. Exclusive discounts: Our affiliates receive exclusive discounts on our products, allowing them to try out our pieces for themselves and share their experiences with their followers.

  5. Personalized support: Our affiliate team provides personalized support to our partners, helping them to optimize their strategies and maximize their earnings.

At Krissy King Swimwear, we value our affiliates and are committed to providing them with the resources and support they need to succeed. By partnering with us, affiliates gain access to a range of exclusive benefits and opportunities, helping them to build their brand and grow their business.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Krissy King! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.

1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.

3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.

4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.

5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.

6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).

7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: info@krissyking.com.

Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to info@krissyking.com for support.
